title: Why Mosquitoes Bite Only You (100x Tastier)
takeaway: Some people's skin smell (carboxylic acids made from skin oil by skin bacteria) makes them up to 100x more attractive to mosquitoes, and it stays the same for years whatever shampoo or food they change.
sources: De Obaldia et al., Cell, 18 Oct 2022 (Vosshall lab, Rockefeller)
pacing_brief: Hook = extreme true fact (up to 100x tastier) said flat by Kalu over a wide shot that already shows the contrast (swarm on Battery, none on Kalu). 28 s, 7 short lines, ~10 shots: cut on every line, one picture insert (skin oil + bacteria -> smell trails -> mosquito follows) carrying the science, held two-shot for the 3-years line, cheek-landing on the defeated line, final wider shot where one mosquito tries Kalu and goes back. Voices at natural speed (atempo 1.0), tight gaps. Ends abruptly on Kalu's sip; loops to the opening contrast.
